description: Close the asset-ingestion gap and expand /mcp from 6 tools to a complete 20-tool primitive vocabulary so an external AI client can build scenes (model homes, properties, city layouts) headlessly: asset upload (REST multipart + MCP base64), asset-bearing node placement, node deletion, MCP wrappers over existing REST ops, and one shared authz/dispatch helper that fixes the create_node/create_petal role-only fallbacks.
notes:
USER DIRECTIVES 2026-07-16 (binding): (1) PRIMITIVES ONLY — no city-semantic verbs (place_building/create_road/footprint queries); the AI composes from low-level tools. (2) Scale is map-authoritative — parallel track map_scale_authority_20260716 owns world_scale-derived placement; this track passes position/rotation/scale through verbatim and invents NO per-asset scale metadata. (3) Runs parallel with road_builder_ux_20260716 (fe-ui only) and map_scale_authority_20260716 — this track stays in fe-api/fe-runtime/fe-database (+fractalengine wiring if needed) and MUST NOT touch fe-ui. Key seam decision: asset bytes never cross the crossbeam channel — API thread writes blobs via its own BlobStoreHandle (main.rs:40 shares one handle between ApiState and the DB thread), only hash/metadata goes to the DB thread. New DbCommand variants (CreateAsset, CreateNodeWithAsset) instead of extending CreateNode, to avoid the ~15-construction-site blast radius incl. fe-ui.
VALIDATED 2026-07-19: pending (confirmed) — zero implementation evidence: no CreateAsset/CreateNodeWithAsset/upload_asset/place_asset/ToolSpec anywhere in fe-api/src, fe-runtime/src, or fe-database/src; fe-api/src/upload.rs and fe-api/tests/mcp_scene_test.rs do not exist. Still 6-tool /mcp surface per spec's stated baseline. remaining: all 5 phases (DB-thread primitives, REST asset ingest, MCP dispatch refactor, 6->20 tool expansion, headless full-loop test) — not started.

VALIDATED 2026-10-09 (F18, conductor reconciliation): status corrected pending -> done. CLOSED by the mission continuation's F13 @635b8c5 (A26): the full 5-phase plan landed in one feature -- a single table-driven ToolSpec/ScopeRule dispatcher (zero inline require_* calls left in handler bodies, this track's Phase 3 Task 3.3 invariant), the complete 20-name primitive vocabulary from Phases 1/2/4 (upload_asset/place_asset/delete_node, set_property/get_properties/delete_property/query, create_waypoint/move_waypoint/import_gpx, set_petal_terrain/list_tilesets/install_tileset/get_gis_nodes, plus the pre-existing 6), the three weak-authz warts this track's spec named fixed (create_node/create_petal/update_transform now scope-checked via the dispatcher instead of role-only fallbacks) plus a decoy variant and a depth-escalation hole caught by automated security review on the new code itself (HierarchyArgs(HierarchyTarget) anchors at the write-target level), and GLB upload writing blobs API-side so asset bytes never cross the bounded crossbeam channel (this track's D1 seam decision, delivered as specced). DEC-C14 (mission continuation spec.md) resolves the 'A26: 20 tools' acceptance language as 'the 20-name vocabulary fully present' -- true tools/list length is 29 (24 + 5 sim-control tools from the concurrent F9 feature), recorded as a documented intentional superset, not a scope miss. This track's primitives-only directive (no city-semantic verbs) and map-authoritative-scale directive (position/rotation/scale passed verbatim) both held -- F13's tripwire test for banned semantic-verb tool names is the Phase 4 Task 4.5 guard this track specified. Phase 5's full-loop MCP acceptance test is the mission's api_mcp_integration_tests closure (F14, see that track's own dated note) rather than a fe-api/tests/mcp_scene_test.rs file in this track -- functionally equivalent coverage, different harness, acceptable substitution. Open item carried forward honestly (not a blocker): MCP install_tileset Manager-vs-REST-Editor role mismatch and set_petal_terrain validate-then-refuse both deferred by F13's own handoff to F14, which did not revisit them -- recorded here for whichever future track next touches fe-api/src/mcp.rs.
